test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option in which the words share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of words.

Desert : Sand
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Desert : Sand ⇒ In a Desert, only Sand will be available at all the times.

Similarly,

Sea : Water ⇒ In a Sea, Water will be available at all the times.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
